page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4r.8xlarge is an instance from the Local SSDs family built on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on the x86_64 architecture and provides 32 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system does not incorporate discrete GPU accelerators.

The instance delivers high memory density with 256 GB of RAM, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Storage architecture is anchored by an integrated 1919 GB local SSD, providing high-bandwidth local read and write access without reliance on separate networked block devices.

Networking performance is rated at a baseline throughput of 16 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. The local SSD and memory density profile offers hardware efficiency for systems bound by disk access latency and RAM constraints.

Target workloads include memory-heavy production environments, relational and non-relational database management systems, distributed caching tiers, transactional processing engines, and large-scale analytical services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4r.8xlarge is a memory-optimized and storage-equipped virtual server within the Local SSDs family, operating under the KVM hypervisor. Driven by 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B vCPUs at 2.7 GHz on x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates 256 GB of system memory, providing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. A bundled 1919 GB local SSD delivers direct-attached disk performance, eliminating standard network latency for disk-bound operations. The instance includes 16 Gbps baseline networking capability, zero GPUs, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With high memory allocation and bundled solid-state local storage, the ecs.i4r.8xlarge is built for memory-heavy and I/O-intensive workloads such as relational databases, distributed caching layers, data processing pipelines, and in-memory transactional processing systems.
